title: Glass Panes pane
description: One pane: a fixed 1080x1920 portrait canvas of positioned widgets. Layout only. No entity IDs here; those live in a bindings file.

background.description: Pure black (#000000) is see-through on a two-way mirror.

theme.description: Optional colour theme. It sets the pane background and the named colours fg, dim, faint and accent (light themes also warn, good and bad). The theme's background replaces `background` unless `own_background` is true. Leave it out for the original look.

own_background.description: With a theme: true keeps this pane's own `background` (true black #000000 when it has none) instead of the theme's, and the theme still sets the text colours. Use it on a mirror, where pure black is see-through and any lit background shows as a visible rectangle. Only for dark themes (a light theme's dark text needs its own light background). Absent or false: the theme's background, as before.

brightness.description: Backlight percent to ask the display for while this pane is showing. Optional.

burn_in_saver.description: Drift the whole pane a few pixels, very slowly (one lap about every 40 minutes), so a screen left on for hours never holds the same pixels. Too slow to notice.

motion.description: How things move on this pane. `widgets: fade` fades a widget in and out when its show-when rule switches it (about half a second). Left out means no fade. Displays that ask for reduced motion never fade.

color.description: A theme token or a #rrggbb value. Tokens: fg #f2f2f2, dim #8a8a8a, faint #5f5f5f, accent #6fb4ff, warn #ffb347, good #5fd38d, bad #ff6b6b.

value.description: above/below/between: a number (the low end for between). is/is_not: a state as text, or a list of texts.

to.description: between: the high end. The range includes both ends.

attribute.description: Test this attribute of the entity instead of its state.

icon.description: Swap the icon of an Icon widget (or the icon beside an entity value) while the rule holds.

show_when.description: A rule that switches a widget on and off. The widget is shown while the rule holds. Never holds an entity id: an entity condition names a slot (when_...) and the entity is bound to that slot in the bindings, like any other widget entity.

match.description: all: every condition must hold. any: one is enough.

condition.description: One condition of a show_when rule. kind has_content / empty need `widget`; entity needs `slot` and `test` (and `value` unless test is unavailable); time needs `from` and `to`; days needs `days`.

widget.description: has_content / empty: the other widget to look at. has_content: it is showing something. empty: it is showing nothing (this is how a fallback takes the place of something).

slot.description: entity: the name of the binding slot that holds the entity id, for example when_door. Bind it with set_pane_bindings: {widget id: {when_door: "binary_sensor.xyz"}}.

test.description: entity: is / is_not compare the state (value is one text or a list of texts, any of them); above / below compare a number; unavailable holds when the state is unavailable or unknown. An unbound slot never holds.

value.description: entity: text, a list of texts (is / is_not) or a number (above / below).

from.description: time: start of the window, HH:MM, in the display's timezone.

to.description: time: end of the window (not included). Earlier than `from` means the window runs through midnight.

days.description: days: the days of the week the condition holds.

auto_height.description: Height follows the content instead of staying h. An auto-height widget with nothing to show takes no space.

flow.description: Place this widget below one or more others, wherever they end up, instead of at a fixed y. y still holds the starting position for the builder.

after.description: Widget id, or several (the lowest bottom wins). Anything above that is empty is skipped over.

gap.description: Pixels of space below what it follows.

show_if.description: Only show this widget while the named widget has content (a section title that disappears with its section).

style_rules.description: Conditional formatting for a widget with an `entity` slot (entity value, progress ring, message, image): the first rule that matches the entity's state (or one attribute) changes the widget's colour, size, weight or opacity.

when_hidden.description: What the widget does to the layout when it is switched off by show_when or has nothing to show. collapse (default): it takes no space and whatever flows below it moves up. keep: it holds its box height (h), so the widgets below stay where they are.

show_seconds.description: Digital: show the seconds too. Traditional and alarm clock: draw a red second hand.

style.description: digital: the time as numbers (the original look). analog: a traditional round clock face with hands. alarm: a bedside alarm clock with two bells, feet and a small alarm hand; its case takes the widget's text colour when that is a #rrggbb, else red.

face.description: Traditional and alarm clock only: a light face with dark numerals, or a dark face with light ones (kinder on a mirror).

timezone.description: A time zone name such as America/Chicago or Asia/Tokyo, to show the time somewhere other than the display's own zone. Empty (or a name that is not a time zone) means the display's own.
A time zone name such as America/Chicago, to show the date somewhere other than the display's own zone. Empty means the display's own.

fit.description: shrink = keep to one line and make the text smaller until it fits the box (for mastheads and long titles).

asset.description: File name of an uploaded image. null = empty slot.

media.description: An uploaded picture from the media library (takes the place of `asset`).

refresh_s.description: When an image or camera entity feeds this picture: how often to ask for a new picture, in seconds. Default 10 for a camera and 300 for an image entity (an image entity also updates the moment its state changes).

folder.description: A folder inside a Home Assistant media folder, for example photos/family or local/photos/family. Photos are shrunk to the widget size before the mirror gets them. null = nothing to show.

interval_s.description: Seconds each photo stays on screen.

shuffle.description: Mix the order (every photo once before any repeats). Off = file-name order.

fit.description: contain = the whole photo, with bars if the shapes differ; cover = fill the box and crop the edges.

fade.description: Crossfade between photos. Off = switch instantly (lighter on a small display).

sources.description: Uploaded video file names, tried in order if one fails to play.

media.description: An uploaded video from the media library (takes the place of `sources`).

style.description: How the line is drawn. A box uses solid, dashed or dotted for its outline.

look.description: line: a rule between sections. box: an outline with rounded corners that frames a group of widgets (it is always shown, even with nothing above it).

radius.description: Corner radius of a box, in pixels.

fill.description: Optional soft fill inside a box: a theme colour (fg, dim, faint, accent, warn, good, bad) or #rrggbb.

fill_opacity.description: How strong the box fill is, in percent.

source.description: name: the entity's name. state: its state. attribute: one attribute (give `attribute`). text: fixed words (give `text`), the same in every row.

attribute.description: source attribute: the attribute's name (never an entity id).

format.description: How the value is shown. duration turns minutes (see duration_unit) into '1 h 15 min'; number formats a plain number.

style_rules.description: Conditional formatting of this column's cells, looking at each cell's own value (an `attribute` inside a rule is ignored).

icon.description: A Material Design Icons name such as thermometer or door-open (no mdi: prefix), or auto for the bound entity's own icon. Empty with an entity bound also means auto.
Show an icon before the value: a Material Design Icons name, or auto for the entity's own icon.

look.description: plain: the value as text. tile: a rounded card with the icon in a tinted circle, the name over the value. chip: a small pill with the icon and the value. A tile or chip uses the entity's own icon unless `icon` names another.

show_icon.description: Tile and chip: show the icon.

radius.description: Tile: the corner radius in pixels (a chip is always fully round).

unit.description: null = use the entity's own unit.

attribute.description: Show this attribute of the entity instead of its state (an attribute name, never an entity id).

format.description: How a date, time or duration is shown. duration turns a number of minutes (see duration_unit) into '1 h 15 min'. auto: '12 min ago' for recent moments, a date otherwise; raw: exactly as Home Assistant has it.

duration_unit.description: What a number means when format is duration.

raw_state.description: Show the state as Home Assistant stores it ('on') instead of words ('Open').

skip.description: Leave out the first N events, e.g. the one a separate 'next up' line already shows.

cd_case.description: The cd look only: show the album cover as a CD case with the disc sliding out of its side, instead of the disc alone. Needs album art; without art, or with show_art off, only the disc is drawn.

burn_in_saver.description: Drift the whole widget a few pixels, very slowly (one lap about every 40 minutes), so a screen that is left on for hours never holds the same pixels. Too slow to notice. Works with every look.

style.description: card: album art and words (the original look). vinyl: a black record with the art as its centre label, spinning while playing, with a tonearm that swings on and off. cd: a shiny disc with the art in its centre ring, spinning while playing.

idle_text.description: A message to show when nothing is playing. Empty (the default) shows nothing, so with auto_height the widget takes no space.

stale_days.description: Stop mentioning something that has been offline longer than this. 0 = never stop.

layout.description: line = one text line, rows = logo/score/logo rows, box = compact two-row box scores for narrow columns.

game_day_only.description: Show sports only on game day: live games, tonight's game, and a final only until midnight. Later games are never announced (this overrides show_next). Off keeps a final for about 18 hours, so last night's score is still there in the morning.

verbose_text.description: Spell results out ("Lions win · Final", "Lions play at 7:30") instead of just Final or the time. The scores already show who won.

head_top.description: Rows layout: put the headline (Final, Live, Today · 7 PM) above the logos instead of beside them. For narrow columns.

keywords.description: Used by feeds whose filter is 'keywords'. Empty = every story counts.
